title: Lifecycle Execution Output Manifest v1
description: Complete closed inventory of one provisional Execution Output Carrier after the fixed Cell runner closes every declared output.
$comment: Semantic validation recomputes digest over the complete value without digest, recomputes entryCount, aggregateByteLength, and entryInventoryDigest from entries in ascending normalized path order, rejects duplicate and aliasing paths, opens the contained carrier without following links, proves every entry is one stable regular file with exactly the declared regular or executable mode class, and proves the carrier contains no missing, unknown, extra, post-manifest, directory, link, Gitlink, device, socket, pipe, or special entry. Every entry must match exactly one non-overlapping declared output root in outputContractDigest and its purpose, media type, mode, and bounds. Candidate output uses one optional declared root. If populated, its entries are the complete successor repository tree, not a delta; if omitted, no Candidate output exists. Each Candidate entry must be strictly below that root; validation strips exactly the root plus one slash, refuses an empty or non-normalized result, and maps regular and executable classes only to repository-valid Git modes 100644 and 100755. Runner-written digests are claims until the Runtime independently rehashes every byte.

path.description: Normalized carrier-relative file path. For candidate-output this must be strictly below its declared root and maps to the repository path after that exact root prefix is stripped.
